description: List and search this workspace's contacts, filtered by company/owner/tag, sorted and paginated. Returns summary rows (id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, jobTitle, company, owner, tags) plus pagination { page, perPage, total }. Use get_contact to fetch one contact's full detail by id.

companyId.description: Filter to contacts at this company id (from search_companies).

ownerId.description: Filter to contacts owned by this workspace member's user id.

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Number of contacts per page (1-100). Default 25.

q.description: Free-text search over name, email and company. Omit for no text filter.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Default name. Allowed: name, email, createdAt.

tag.description: Filter to contacts carrying this tag. Omit for any tag.

name: search_contacts
title: Search contacts
